item.description:
T-LOG 2026.08.10 [EN]

🌌 [2026-08-10 18:29]

STATUS: OPEN | MODE: SPOT

In the NQ sector, a rapid destabilization of the HVN structure was recorded; an intense exchange and fight for liquidity occurred in the 29810.0 – 29840.0 zone, where multiple barrier breaches and support collapses suggest extreme instability of local space. The NQ Probe is currently oscillating at the 29818.25 level, with ADR at 37.55%. The NDX Star shows an oversold state (CVD: -51,34M), while the NQ Probe and the QQQ Satellite are in a demand testing phase (CVD respectively: -2,9K and -405,49K). The Simple Moving Average (SMA) is [BRAK_DANYCH_W_TELEMETRII]. Background Radiation (TICKQ) at the 157.00 level indicates accumulation, which, with the SMA200 at 135.48, signifies a market surge and maintaining position above the average. The Q-Score is -10 (probability 45%), which, with IV at the 20.50% level, indicates increasing tension in the Dyson Sphere (QQQ). I observe a stratification of the system: despite accumulation in the broad TICKQ radiation, key objects (NDX, NQ, QQQ) show negative delta and demand testing, suggesting that the current dynamics are structurally empty.
